findings.statement: DexTrading's 00:28 UTC snapshot shows cbXRP around $1.25, $3.57M 24-hour volume, $485K liquidity in the main Aero cbXRP/WETH pool and 4,965 trades (2,477 buys, 2,488 sells). Other displayed Base pools include cbXRP/cbBTC on Aero, cbXRP/WETH on PancakeSwap and cbXRP/USDC on Uniswap V3. The 7.36x volume-to-main-pool-liquidity ratio indicates turnover, not net capital inflow.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Single aggregator snapshot; pool liquidity is not guaranteed executable depth and buy/sell trade counts do not measure notional net flow.

findings.statement: CoinDesk's opened page displays 107.04M cbXRP supply, while Trading Strategy's cached page body displays 60.95M and its search snippet displays 151.403M. These are stale/inconsistent against Coinbase's first-party 151.403M supply display. The third-party values are excluded from current supply estimates.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase's own page is first-party but not an independent audit; independent direct contract supply verification remains pending.

market_observations.notes: Buy/sell trade counts are almost balanced. Volume-to-liquidity ratio is turnover, not a measure of net inflow.
The page is materially stale relative to Coinbase's current first-party reserve/supply display.
Search snippet and opened page body conflict; do not treat the snippet as independent corroboration.

competing_hypotheses.claim: cbXRP has active Base DEX turnover and multiple pools, but the current provider snapshot shows almost balanced buy/sell counts and does not demonstrate net external capital inflow or a directional price signal.
supporting_evidence: DexTrading reports $3.57M 24-hour volume, $485K main-pool liquidity and 4,965 trades at 00:28 UTC.
Buys (2,477) and sells (2,488) are nearly balanced.
Additional cbXRP pairs are displayed on Aero, PancakeSwap and Uniswap V3.
disconfirming_evidence: Trade counts are not notional amounts and the provider does not independently identify wash trading or arbitrage.
One aggregator snapshot cannot establish sustained liquidity or institutional collateral utilization.
unknowns: Pair-level notional buy/sell volumes and order-book/slippage curves.
On-chain mint/burn flows, LP position concentration and DeFi collateral utilization.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Third-party cbXRP supply pages are stale or internally inconsistent; Coinbase's first-party proof-of-reserves page is the best available published reserve/supply reference, but independent Base contract verification is still needed.
supporting_evidence: CoinDesk opened page reports 107.04M and older market values.
Trading Strategy opened body reports 60.95M while its search snippet says 151.403M.
disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase first-party page itself is not an independent audit and its displayed refresh time varies by locale/cache.
unknowns: Current on-chain totalSupply() from an accessible independent Base RPC.
Whether third-party providers are delayed, indexing bridged supply differently or using stale caches.

relationship_edges.to_entity: Base DEX pools: Aero, PancakeSwap, Uniswap V3
relationship_edges.details: Pairs include cbXRP/WETH, cbXRP/cbBTC and cbXRP/USDC.
7.36x turnover relative to displayed pool liquidity; not net inflow.
Trade counts nearly balanced; notional amounts not disclosed.
Independent Base contract totalSupply() read remains outstanding.

Capture pool-level swap events and notional buy/sell amounts for Aero, PancakeSwap and Uniswap V3; calculate slippage curves and LP concentration.
Track cbXRP mint/burn events against Coinbase XRPL reserve addresses to estimate actual XRP lockup and release.
